database_core.evidence: Frankenstack v0.14 exercised Database Core v0.46 through MySQL wire

foreign_runtime.note: User supplied archive in current conversation; exact bytes are not mounted in this certification runtime, so no local SHA/test claim is made here.

msqlshim: MySQL/MariaDB wire server framing/session/cursor compatibility only

required_gates.requirement: With compatible Foreign Runtime and libsqlite3 available, auto mode selects the foreign provider and reports it observably.
With libsqlite3 deliberately unavailable, auto mode uses the existing pure-ooRexx SQLite implementation and reports the fallback reason.
With libsqlite3 unavailable, forced foreign mode fails explicitly and never silently falls back.
Forced native mode uses the pure-ooRexx implementation even when libsqlite3 is present.
For the common supported GeoPackage surface, foreign and ooRexx providers agree on tables, schema, NULLs, scalar values, BLOB bytes, geometry bytes/type/SRID and query results.
Each provider advertises only operations actually qualified; unsupported write/transaction/savepoint/WAL behavior fails explicitly.
Provider selection does not change GeoPackage, geometry, SRID, federation or ST_* semantics.
libpq path proves parameterized query and one-handle BEGIN/SAVEPOINT/ROLLBACK TO/COMMIT semantics.
libmariadb/libmysqlclient path proves parameterized query and one-handle transaction semantics.
Database Core native MySQL client successfully traverses real MySQL wire through unchanged msqlshim into NoSQLServer.
OGR catalogue/schema discovery is observational; row materialisation occurs only on row demand.
GEOS-backed supported predicates match the ooRexx reference implementation over deterministic and adversarial geometry corpora.
CRS transformation occurs only through an explicit transform operation; mixed-SRID predicates never trigger silent reprojection.
PGconn/MYSQL/sqlite3/GDAL/GEOS/PROJ handles are never semantic identity, serialized authority, journal material or provenance identity.

release_rule: Gate remains red until exact owner-produced candidate archives are supplied and all applicable required gates have executable evidence.
